Show operations and reliability.
For Lakeshore Holdings, here is the current operations and reliability picture:
• **Two high-severity controls are the immediate story.** Bank connectivity (Kyriba Treasury / Oracle Fusion ERP) has two uncertified opco bank feeds, and Northline carrier feed quality (Northline TMS / Fleet Telematics) is directly blocking AI dispatch scale — these are not future risks, they are active constraints today.
• **Four medium controls signal compounding friction.** Manual close reconciliation across Oracle Fusion ERP and Workday, incomplete legacy migration in Ironclad CLM, variable opco KPI refresh in DealCloud / Azure Data Lakehouse, and pending AI model-risk business context in the Governance Registry / Databricks Workspace each slow a different part of the operating model.
• **The pattern matters more than any single item.** Data quality is the common thread — resolving it unlocks treasury confidence, AI scale, and portfolio visibility simultaneously.
Lakeshore Holdings should validate source ownership and control freshness before treating any item as closed.
**Branch:** Tower for prioritization and value impact — Source for Ironclad CLM migration and vendor feed certification — Intelligence for AI governance tradeoffs — Moves for remediation sequencing across opcos.
